batch_defaults.basis: operator request for ten; four is an authored conservative batch

pro-decision.thinking: Pro selection; no separate effort asserted
pro-decision.rationale: Authored recommendation for expensive judgment and synthesis.

reasoned-standard.thinking: High; Extra High for a harder bounded review when available
reasoned-standard.rationale: Authored default for routine structured reasoning.

image-execution.thinking: Images with thinking when exposed and useful
image-execution.rationale: Use actual image capability, not a guessed text-model combination.

deep-research-execution.rationale: Depth/source-policy workflow, separate from Pro reasoning.

tool-analysis.preferred_model: available reasoning model with required tools
tool-analysis.thinking: High or Extra High where available
tool-analysis.tool_requirement: file/vision/Python or artifact tools as requested
tool-analysis.rationale: Tool compatibility is checked before premium-model preference.

known_facts.fact: GPT-6 Pro is documented for Pro $100 and Pro $200; exact account tier and remaining allowance are unknown here.
Sol uses Instant, Medium, High and Extra High labels; model/thinking must be selected in the UI, not assumed from a request to think harder.
Chat Deep Research has a separate task allowance; it can use permitted web/files and supported read-only app sources.
Images can be created or edited with text, requested aspect ratios and transparent backgrounds; exact results still need QA.
The upload FAQ lists 40 files per Pro Project and 20 MB per image; other limits and account state also apply.

unknowns: per-model tool compatibility in the user's session
